findings.finding: The author of the final memorandum identifies the interim report as dated June 10, 2017, and attributes to it the recommendation that the President ask Congress for authority for tribal co-management within revised Bears Ears boundaries. The later DOI testimony attests submission to the President by January 30, 2018. Page 9 does not date transmission, establish receipt, or inventory the whole interim report.

In its June 12, 2017 release the Secretary’s office specifically dates submission of the interim report to President Trump to June 10. This matches the date attributed to the document on held page 9 on an independent documentary basis; it does not arise by adding 45 days. The public interim memorandum identifies its recipient and Bears Ears recommendations; neither item is a routing log or a receipt. Do not infer exhaustive compliance or exact first end.

findings.evidence_tier: held plus separately identified public sources
findings.finding: The retained memorandum identifies itself as a final report. Testimony says a final report was submitted by January 30, 2018. The August 24 release and DOI answers call what was sent that day a draft; the answers separately date public release of the final to December 5. Neither August 24 nor December 5 establishes when a final version was transmitted or received. This does not exclude some additional transmission on either date. Do not attribute an exact transmission, delivery, first end, or timeliness to the final command.

Testimony connects the President’s December 4 action to a recommendation; EO13990 names Proclamation 9681 as the separate instrument establishing the boundaries it orders the Secretary to review. Its section 3 calls for a new review and report on possible restoration; section 7(a) revokes EO13792. Those provisions do not themselves restore the former boundary, prove continuation of the old reporting commands, or supply a date for their exhaustion. This qualifies the existing savings rationale, which already recognized independent authority, and does not determine monument status at cutoff.

unresolved.sec2d: Obtain exact transmitted version and contemporaneous routing/address/receipt through all four named offices; compare final interim memorandum and its findings/recommendations to section 2(d). Do not turn the factual dispatch date into a legal endpoint without an independent sufficiency and exhaustion judgment.
unresolved.sec2e: Distinguish the August draft, published revised final and actual final transmission. Locate dated final transmittal/receipt, routing and version, or explicitly retain uncertainty. The available official sources do not disprove a final transmission on August 24 but do not prove one.
unresolved.whole_order: Original review/consultation commands and any separately authorized consequences require their own evidence. No whole-order replacement or claim about later validity of the proclamations.
